name: Low Power Mode and Battery Saver
plain: Tells an app whether the person turned on the system power-saving mode.
meaning: Shows the person is low on battery or conserving it. Apps use it to cut background work; it is a minor context signal.

android.note: Battery Saver on or off, plus an automatic trigger at about 15 percent in many builds

ios.api_surface: Automatic prompt at 20 percent battery; boolean only

limits.headline: Can tell if Battery Saver or Low Power Mode is on, but cannot change it
limits.user_action: Nothing. You turn the mode on yourself, or your phone does at low battery
can: Check if Low Power Mode (iPhone) or Battery Saver (Android) is on
Get told when you switch it on or off
Slow down or pause downloads and animations to save power
cannot: Turn the mode on or off for you
See why it is on; the phone starts it at about 20 percent on iPhone and often 15 percent on Android
Get more detail than on or off on iPhone
limits.differs: Android also gives a level of saving in some versions. iPhone gives on or off only.

story.what_it_is: An app can tell if you turned on the phone's power saving mode.

marketing.name: Low Power Mode
marketing.pitch: Support page: reduces background activity to extend battery life when your iPhone is running low.

story.for_you: When you switch on power saving, apps may slow down animations, pause syncing or lower video quality. You notice it as a quieter, simpler app. The app knows your battery is tight.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to be kind to your battery and avoid bad reviews. It is a small context signal and rarely used alone for tracking.

use_cases.example: A game lowers frame rate and stops background music when you turn on Low Power Mode.
A video app drops to lower quality and pauses auto play previews.
A tracking app samples GPS less often to last through a long run.
A feed app stops auto loading videos and refreshes less often.
A navigation app dims the screen sooner and reduces map redraws.
A home app stops live camera previews until you tap them.

story.android_note: Android calls it Battery Saver and apps can read its state.
story.ios_note: iPhone calls it Low Power Mode and apps can read a simple on or off flag.
